high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "mansionstyles," which is located in New Rochelle, New York. The post features an aerial view of a luxurious property situated on a small island surrounded by water. The main structure of the house is a large, white building with a red-tiled roof, featuring multiple windows and a symmetrical design. There is a circular driveway leading up to the house, and a well-maintained lawn surrounds it.
